messages:
Alex K: Quick sync — dress rehearsal for the launch orchestra tomorrow 10:00am PT. Goal: validate press embargo, microsite cutover, SI onboarding hooks, and partner HW sample delivery windows. Who can make the 10am dry run?
Mira P: I can. I'll own the press embargo checklist. Updated checklist here: https://redwood-internal/ops/launch-orchestra/checklist (see 'Press' tab) :white_check_mark:
Jordan S: I'll be on staging cutover. Need final DNS TTLs from eng-infra before we flip canary. @eng-infra FYI.
Samir R: HW partner (NimbleEdge) confirmed serialized firmware bundles. First shipment tracking TB12345 -> expected Tue EOD. Partner needs portal invite before samples ship.
Tia Chen: Localization status: ES + DE done for blog + landing. FR pending legal signoff. Also pushing a quick review for alt text on hero image.
Priya V: Looping legal now for FR. They said tentative signoff by 17:00 PT today. Will confirm. Also flagged privacy blurb for partner data flows.
Alex K: Press embargo window is 9:00am PT embargo on day-of. We need a backup APAC contact for press in case morning APAC picks up the story. @Miguel S can you provide a regional PR contact? :eyes:
Miguel S: Miguel (Partner PM): I have a PR contact in APAC (Keiko). Sharing details in DM. Approving SI logos on landing now — don't swap positions.
deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded — build 2026.03.20.57 (runtime: 3m21s). Canary namespace created: launch-orchestra-canary-23
Jordan S: Reduced DNS TTLs to 60s across canary records. Will monitor propagation. Will run the cutover smoke script at +30m.
Samir R: Partner portal invites queued (partner-ops team). Notified NimbleEdge contacts; they confirmed access. I also added shipment docs to the shared drive.
Mira P: Press assets update: hero image approved, alt text added, embargoed press release uploaded. Added SI logos to landing — Miguel approved. Need final signoff from design on mobile sizing.
Alex K: Quick preflight command we'll run at 09:50am PT before rehearsal:
```
/run preflight --stage=staging --check=assets,press,cdn,dns,si-onboarding
```
Alex K: Action items recap: Alex -> coordinate press embargo & APAC backup; Mira -> upload + QA assets; Jordan -> monitor DNS/cutover; Samir -> confirm shipping & portal invites; Tia -> confirm FR legal; Priya -> chase legal; Miguel -> confirm logos & APAC PR contact. Live rehearsal at 09:50am PT, full dress at 10:00am PT.
Tia Chen: Noted, I'll ping legal and confirm FR by 17:00.
Priya V: Legal acked — FR ready, will DM copy and mark approved in the doc.
Miguel S: APAC PR contact shared in DM.
Alex K: Thanks all — see you tomorrow. :rocket:
